item.title: 51 Of The Cringiest And Funniest Texts That Might Make You Laugh Out Loud Or Facepalm
item.description: Humor isn’t only there to entertain us… It’s woven into the way we communicate every day. Whether it’s sending a ridiculous GIF to a friend to brighten their morning or dropping a sarcastic one-liner in a group chat, humor is everywhere — even in the small, everyday moments of texting and messaging. item.title: “My Mum Cuts Vegetables For Me”: Lazy BIL Can’t Handle The Fact That Guy With One Arm Can’t Use A Knife
